findings.summary: The committed data file's class_pass holds both_settled_at_zero 867 and above_cutoff_count 221 across 145 members, with per-name probabilities from an earlier reading (breakdown_initial_time over_qualified_modifier 0.52), while the page rendered from it states 854 both-zero and 398 answers across 236 members at docs/evidence/fragments/sn-definitions-by-construction/sdbc-name-review-source-context.html:175; fill_fragment.py:111 renders residual_text from data['class_pass'], so re-running the generator would silently replace the measured 236 with 145. The class clause of the done_when therefore carries two different counts in the same landing, both claiming 0 unexplained.

The planted-qualifier section states 0.93 on over_qualified_modifier and 0.91 on source_fidelity_unsupported_qualifier, while the same document at :106 states 0.91 / 0.89 for that name and the committed name-review-source-context.json records 0.9 / 0.9; three readings of one planted run are carried at once, and only the run-directory artifact would settle which print is the one to quote.

_QUALIFIER_CONTRASTS restates a negation vocabulary the repository already holds: imas_codex/standard_names/docs_gates.py:803 _NEUTRAL_NEGATION_RE carries most of the same words for the same purpose (deciding whether prose denies the term it names). The new set is sentence-scoped and extended with contrast words, so it is a narrower owner-adjacent list rather than a full capability fork, but the two lists can drift.

enclosing_structure_statements now issues one graph round trip per bound path inside the loop, where the deleted _ENCLOSING_STRUCTURE_QUERY batched every path into one statement. A review batch pays a query per source path instead of one per call.
